about.text: Colostrum from pregnant cows vaccinated against the strains of E. coli that cause traveller's diarrhoea, so that their first milk is full of antibodies against them. Freeze-dried to a powder and pressed into tablets, sold as Travelan; a large trial in 2025 found it gave little protection.

links.name: Otto et al., Scandinavian Journal of Gastroenterology (2011)

how.text: The cow is the antibody factory: vaccinated while pregnant, she puts the antibodies into her colostrum. That is dried and sold as tablets, taken with meals while travelling.
